title: Scale3
description: A per-axis UNITLESS scale factor triple. Separate from vec3.schema.json (meters) and euler-radians.schema.json (radians) so no contract can silently mix quantities. This is the object's transform scale, not its physical size: physical size is dimensions_meters. Spec 002 keeps the two distinct because 'make it 20% smaller' is design-space SIZE intent (set_object_dimensions, absolute meters) while 'set its scale to 0.8' is explicit TRANSFORM-SCALE intent (scale_object). Negative values are representable because Blender permits mirrored scale; zero is degenerate and rejected by the validation layer rather than by JSON Schema.
